List performance metrics for a bucket.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `continuation_token` | query | string |  | A token used to retrieve the next page of data with some consistency guaranteed. The token is a Base64 encoded value. Set `continuation_token` to the system-generated token taken from the `x-next-token` header field of… |
| `end_time` | query | integer (int64) |  | When the time window ends (in milliseconds since epoch). |
| `filter` | query | string |  | Narrows down the results to only the response objects that satisfy the filter criteria. |
| `ids` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of resource IDs. If after filtering, there is not at least one resource that matches each of the elements of `ids`, then an error is returned. This cannot be provided together with the `name` or… |
| `limit` | query | integer (int32) |  | Limits the size of the response to the specified number of objects on each page. To return the total number of resources, set `limit=0`. The total number of resources is returned as a `total_item_count` value. If the… |
| `names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the unique names specified. Enter multiple names in comma-separated format. For example, `name01,name02`. If there is not at least one resource that matches each of the elements of `names`,… |
| `offset` | query | integer (int32) |  | The offset of the first resource to return from a collection. |
| `resolution` | query | integer (int64) |  | The desired ms between samples. Available resolutions may depend on data type, `start_time` and `end_time`. In general `1000`, `30000`, `300000`, `1800000`, `7200000`, and `86400000` are possible values. |
| `sort` | query | array of string |  | Sort the response by the specified fields (in descending order if '-' is appended to the field name). NOTE: If you provide a sort you will not get a `continuation_token` in the response. |
| `start_time` | query | integer (int64) |  | When the time window starts (in milliseconds since epoch). |
| `total_only` | query | boolean |  | If set to `true`, returns the aggregate value of all items after filtering. Where it makes more sense, the average value is displayed instead. The values are displayed for each name where meaningful. If… |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `BucketPerformanceGetResponse`
